entities.summary: Viktor Filippovich Rashnikov is a Russian engineer and a billionaire businessman. An oligarch, he made his wealth in the iron and steel industry, being the majority owner of Magnitogorsk Iron & Steel Works (MMK), one of the world's leading steel producers.
